b: It’s that time of year again, when we share our top men’s gift ideas from Huckberry. It’s hard to go wrong with getting family members and friends any of these featured items, and if you need even more options, check out Huckberry’s entire holiday shop. It’s stocked with tons of varied, unique, and high-quality gifts that’ll please the guys in your life (they’ve got a shop for the gals too) — and it’ll give you some inspiration for what to put on your own wish list.

1. Huckberry X GORUCK Rucking Weight Vest. When it comes to rucking, some people prefer using a backpack to carry the weight, while others like using a vest. The advantage of a vest is that it distributes weight more evenly around your torso and allows for greater freedom of movement. This unique vest from Huckberry and GORUCK is made not with standard nylon but a waxed canvas that will develop a patina with time. While its look is a throwback, its ergonomics have been advanced for a more comfortable carry. Get some of GORUCK’s plates along with it and any guy will be happy to test it out right on Christmas Day.

2. Taylor Stitch Ojai Chore Coat. Inspired by French workwear from the 1800s and modernized with heavyweight brown corduroy for more of a ‘70s vibe, this chore coat from Taylor Stitch is likely to be your new go-to outer layer when the temps dip. Made with quality materials and construction, it’s cozy and handsome and has that unbeatable corduroy texture.

3. Shokz OpenRun Pro 2. Unlike earbuds, these bone conduction headphones will consistently stay in place and not seal off your awareness of the external environment. Shokz’s flagship model incorporates the best available bluetooth technology and is the perfect gift for the athlete that burns through a lot of hours in the gym or miles on the pavement — or both.

4. Redcat Racing Scout II 4WD RC Rock Crawler. Practical gifts are always appreciated, but fun ones are, too. This 1:18 scale RC version of the iconic International Scout II is bound to bring a smile to a guy’s face. With serious torque and tight turning, it packs heavy-duty capability into a mini frame and is ready to handle everything from backyard boulders to indoor obstacle courses.

5. Timex Expedition Field Watch. This titanium field watch is perfect for someone who needs a tough and durable timepiece without extra weight or bulkiness. Features an automatic movement, luminous dial details, and water resistance up to 200 meters. Looks dang sharp, to boot.

6. Benchmade Osborne. Benchmade makes awesome knives, and the Osborne is their flagship for a reason. It’s durable, reliable, holds a sharp edge for damn near ever, and is easily deployed one-handed. This particular edition offers a unique and very cool copper-colored blade.

7. The Essential Johnny Cash Vinyl. No other artist may sound better on vinyl than Johnny Cash, and no other is more of a no-brainer to include in a record collection. The Essential Johnny Cash brings together some of the Man in Black’s greatest hits, from “I Walk the Line” to “Ring of Fire” and “Folsom Prison Blues.” A great gift for longtime Cash fans or someone just discovering his music.

8. Proof PatinaTech Hoodie. A hoodie that combines three elements into one great sweatshirt: vintage look, advanced tech, and inviting softness. This technical hoodie wicks away sweat and stretches when needed, but the fleece interior ensures you aren’t sacrificing coziness. Available in a variety of subtle but distinct colors, it looks as good at the gym as paired with jeans.

9. Camp Wandawega Wood Duck Pillow. Crafted with a traditional hooked textile technique, this duck pillow not only looks great but will hold up for the long haul too. The rich color and texture of it add a handsome, rustic flair to any space, bringing an outdoorsy spirit right to your living room, bedroom, or home office.

10. Snow Peak Alpha Breeze. This unique tent has doors on all four sides, maximizing airflow and preventing the awkwardness of crawling over your tentmates for a nighttime bathroom run or when you want to make coffee before everyone else is up. It also features a large flap that doubles as an awning, creating a personal covered porch.
This article was originally published on The Art of Manliness.
